I couldn’t reach live APIs for "Delhi", but here are curated Onedrly picks you can explore right now:

### Manali
A Himalayan hill town in Himachal Pradesh famed for snow-capped peaks, apple orchards, and adventure sports. Perfect for honeymooners, backpackers, and anyone chasing cool weather.
• Must-see: Hadimba Devi Temple & ancient cedar forest, Solang Valley for paragliding, ATV rides, ziplining
• Food highlight: Johnson’s Café (trout specialties)
• Best for: Adventure, Snow lovers, Backpackers

### Goa
India’s sunshine state with a mix of Portuguese heritage, vibrant nightlife, serene beaches, and world-class seafood.
• Must-see: Baga, Anjuna & Vagator party belt, Fontainhas Latin Quarter heritage walk
• Food highlight: Gunpowder (Goan-meets-Andhra cuisine)
• Best for: Nightlife, Beach bums, Foodies

### Shimla
Colonial-era hill station known for toy trains, pine forests, and views of the lower Himalayas. Ideal for family holidays and vintage charm.
• Must-see: The Ridge & Mall Road promenades, Jakhoo Temple (ropeway available)
• Food highlight: Cafe Simla Times
• Best for: Families, History lovers, Slow travel
